title: Checklist sweep M4: zero-citation packages since 18.3.0 and the coverage.json close-out
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzjFj4aaaJk1VJLqRdC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word: epic #32022 "Ownership", the maintainer in the `qa#2` seat session, verbatim 「你可以再开一个 devx 座位，处理相关清单卡」 then 「相关卡立一个专题」; the epic's Milestones table has this seat card M4 once M2 lands (M2 #32020's PR #32259 is in the merge queue, 2026-11-10).

Blocked-by: #32269

Parent: the checklist epic #32022. Milestone M4, the close-out. It waits on M3 (#32269) because both write the same area files and `coverage.json` (one writer per area file, SWEEP.md).

## What

1. **Zero-citation packages.** List every package changed since 18.3.0 (`83d7e4ae`) that no checklist item's `source[]` cites, from `docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json` and the citation scan the `checklist-author` skill describes. For each: author the item(s) its user-visible behaviour needs (`since: "v18.4"`), or record in `coverage.json` why it needs none (internal-only, test-only, covered through a named item that exercises it).
2. **`coverage.json` close-out.** Reconcile it against M1–M4 so that every theme of #32022 maps to its items, and blocked or planned items say why.
3. **Epic table.** Leave #32022's Milestones table current; the PR body lists the final `since:v18.4` count (runnable and `--include-blocked`) for the QA seat's release-candidate run.

## Rules

- New items follow README.md "Item anatomy" and cite their files. A declared-but-absent capability is `planned`, never coverage.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` is green; `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json` lists the new items.
- Defects or doc drift go to `FOLLOW-UPS.md` per SWEEP.md. Security findings follow `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md`.

## File surface

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md`. No product code.

## Done when

No package changed since 18.3.0 is left uncited without a recorded reason, `coverage.json` maps every theme, the checker is green, and the PR has merged.
